structure: Main prediction: an accident is about to happen in the middle of the office.
Explain the clues: the tall stack of boxes, the cable on the floor, the woman looking at her phone.
Add a second prediction (the 'Fragile' box on the desk) and how others might react.
Finish with what will happen afterwards.
modelAnswer: I think there's going to be an accident in the next few seconds. In the middle of the picture, a mover in a blue uniform is carrying a stack of four boxes that's taller than he is, so he can't really see the floor ahead of him. Right in his path, there's a black cable lying across the carpet, so he'll probably trip over it. At the same time, a woman is walking toward him with two cups of coffee, and she's looking at her phone instead of watching where she's going. My guess is that they'll bump into each other, the top box, which is already tilting, will fall, and she'll spill coffee everywhere. On top of that, on the desk on the left, there's a box marked "Fragile" hanging over the edge, so if anyone knocks the desk, it'll end up on the floor. Hopefully, the man on the ladder will see what's happening and shout a warning. Afterwards, I'm sure someone will move that cable out of the way.

usefulExpressions.expression: There's going to be… in the next few seconds
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Dự đoán chắc chắn dựa trên bằng chứng rõ ràng trong tranh
Ngay trên đường anh ấy đi có… — chỉ ra manh mối nguy hiểm
Thay vì nhìn đường — giải thích nguyên nhân sự cố
Cách nói tự nhiên để đưa ra dự đoán
Thêm vào đó — thêm một dự đoán phụ
Rốt cuộc sẽ rơi xuống sàn — nói kết quả cuối cùng

commonMistakes: Chỉ nói một dự đoán rồi hết ý; hãy chuẩn bị 2–3 dự đoán (người khuân hộp, người cầm cà phê, hộp 'Fragile').
Dùng 'fall' sai dạng: 'the box will falls / will fell' → 'the box will fall'.
Nói 'he will be fall down' → đúng là 'he will fall' hoặc 'he will trip over the cable'.
